metas.name: 1 · ★ 5.7 · 2013 · Percy Jackson: Sea of Monsters
metas.description: In order to restore their dying safe haven, the son of Poseidon and his friends embark on a quest to the Sea of Monsters, to find the mythical Golden Fleece, all the while trying to stop an ancient evil from rising.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 5.9 · 2010 · Percy Jackson & the Olympians: The Lightning Thief
metas.description: A teenager discovers he's the descendant of a Greek god and sets out on an adventure to settle an on-going battle between the gods.
